subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): openclaw worker mode running the embedded loop on the box

question: Must `openclaw worker` itself guarantee that local coding tools receive a scrubbed credential-free environment, or may that security property rely exclusively on the external orchestrator?
rationale: The PR promises that ephemeral workers hold no standing credentials, but the current runtime permits inherited process environment values to reach model-invoked subprocesses; choosing the enforcement owner is a security-boundary decision.

options.title: Enforce in worker runtime
options.body: Build an explicit environment allowlist or scrubbed tool environment inside `openclaw worker`, with regression coverage proving ambient secrets and agent sockets are unavailable.

options.title: Rely on orchestrator isolation
options.body: Document the launcher environment as part of the trusted computing base and provide real deployment proof that no sensitive variables or sockets reach the worker process.

recommendation.title: Enforce in worker runtime
recommendation.body: Build an explicit environment allowlist or scrubbed tool environment inside `openclaw worker`, with regression coverage proving ambient secrets and agent sockets are unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged cloud-worker contract stack and authored the credential-free worker design consumed here.
